annotations.title: One site's failed checks: when, where, how, and whether each counted against uptime

description: Wraps GET /api/sites/{slug}/failures. One site's failed checks: when, where, how, and whether each counted against uptime. Call this when uptime shows failures but no incident explains them: each failed check (time, page, location, status, how it failed, whether it counted, its incident), and failures by day for the whole window. One failure alone opens no incident.
name: sites_by_slug_failures

byDay.description: failures a day over the whole window, from the same totals uptime is read from; days without any left out

unconfirmed.description: failures the other location saw working

checks.description: each failed check in the window that raw checks still cover, newest first, at most 200

failure.description: how it failed, in our fixed words (never the site's text)

incident.description: the incident it belongs to (/api/incidents/{id}); null when it opened none (one failure alone doesn't)

status.description: the HTTP status; null when there was no answer

uptime.description: counted: against uptime; unconfirmed: the other location got an answer, so not counted; maintenance: in a maintenance window, not counted

listedFrom.description: where the list starts: the window's start, or how far back raw checks are kept (ISO 8601, UTC)

older.description: checks_expired: the window reaches past how long raw checks are kept, so failures before listedFrom are counted by day, not listed; null otherwise

truncated.description: more than 200 failed: the newest are listed

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call

title: One site's failed checks: when, where, how, and whether each counted against uptime
